text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains in the low 3% range over 24 hours, suggesting steady upward momentum rather than panic or euphoria. The Fear & Greed index sits at extreme fear (11) with minimal improvement over the week, indicating markets remain deeply skeptical despite the price movement—a typical divergence when institutional or technical buying enters a pessimistic environment. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 58% alongside $86B in daily volume shows capital is rotating across altcoins rather than flowing entirely to the majors, though without conviction behind the broader rally.
